ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Moss reads your age, sex, height and weight from Health for your targets; your steps, water, mindful minutes and sleep to light up those habits on their own; and what your watch measures at night for the Sleep section.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Moss never writes to Health: it only reads the data you choose.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Moss uses the camera to read the barcode and the nutrition label of what you eat, and for a meal photo if you want one. The photos never leave your phone.
